In retrosynthesis, we break the C-C bond between aromatic ring and carbonyl carbon, giving aromatic halide and acyl chloride. So the precursors would be aromatic halide (COc1cccc(Cl)c1) and acyl chloride (something like ClC(=O)R). But the given precursors include NC(=O)... which is not acyl chloride.
